---
title: "Create a new partner"
description: "An image from the static"
---

![An image from the static](/images/partners-partner2-bf39e06530bae5aa2fb147ba7e561c2b.png)

<Steps>
  <Step title="Click the create partner button">

    To create a new partner, click the blue button in the top right corner looking like this

    ![An image from the static](data:image/png;base64,)

  </Step>

  <Step title="Define the partner's information">

    A pop-up window will appear where the Partners information needs to be defined before the Partner can be created.

    ![An image from the static](/images/partners-partner-1a03995fa5d070a50345a9d097043bea.png)

    - Name - Specify the Partner’s name
    - Segment – Choose the corresponding level of access.
    - Languages – Choose the Partner’s language.

    <Tip>

    </Tip>

  </Step>
</Steps>
